mentions.name: Mobile coding agent sandbox app
mentions.description: This mobile app spins up sprites.dev sandboxes, lets users log in with their coding agent CLI or subscription (Claude Code and Codex currently supported), connect other services such as GitHub and Vercel, and run and manage their coding agents through a convenient chat interface. It supports multiple models/providers (crush/opencode/glm-5.2 planned) to avoid vendor lock-in, and sandboxes sleep when agents aren't running and wake up in under 5 seconds. A TestFlight demo is available with a Play Store release planned; it is an alpha but functional version.
mentions.problem: Coding agents normally require a home server or an open, working laptop, and people want to execute ideas while away from their laptops without trusting opaque automation or being vendor-locked.
mentions.audience: For people who don't own a home server, don't like keeping their laptops open and working, don't want to trust tooling like openclaw, want to keep working with their usual day-to-day harness without vendor lock-in, and want a way to execute ideas while away from their laptops.
